portraits.name: You, the young Mahler nephew
portraits.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE transparent 2 by 2 expression sprite sheet for a 320x240 DOS Gothic adventure. Edit target/reference: supplied portrait of You, the young Mahler nephew. Preserve this exact person's face, age, hairstyle, clothing, colors and painterly Victorian comic style. Create four clearly distinct expressive upper-chest busts, each isolated on REAL transparent alpha. Layout: exact equal 2x2 grid cells, no lines, no labels, no text, no scenery, generous transparent gutters; every head and both shoulder edges entirely within its own cell. Consistent scale, position, lighting and head angle in all four cells, with the nose and gaze pointed distinctly to the VIEWER'S RIGHT (three-quarter near-profile, as if talking to another person on their right, not to camera). Top-left: attentive neutral, relaxed mouth and eyebrows. Top-right: troubled, sorrowful concern, knit raised inner eyebrows and downturned mouth. Bottom-left: firm determined serious, lowered resolute eyebrows and set jaw. Bottom-right: warmly reassured with unmistakable gentle closed-mouth smile, softened eyes and slightly lifted cheeks. Expressions must read clearly even at 96 pixels tall but remain human and subtle enough for a grave Gothic story. Warm amber face light, deep brown/teal shadows. Opaque person with crisp silhouette, transparent everywhere outside each bust. Do not include rectangular dark backgrounds, frames or drop shadows. Same character exactly four times, full hair and shoulders visible, no extra objects.
